sections.title: The letter vé
paragraphs: The letter (vé) /ve/ makes one regular sound. You hear this sound in the word (vélo) /ve.lo/, which means bicycle.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Place your upper teeth gently on your lower lip. Push air out through the small gap. Turn your voice on so your throat vibrates. You can feel this shake by putting your hand on your throat.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: The letter (vé) /ve/ always makes the same sound in regular positions. You hear it at the start of (vent) /vɑ̃/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not round both lips like the sound in water. Always touch your lower lip to your upper teeth, like the consonant in very. Turn your voice on so it does not sound like ferry.
